falsifiable_hypothesis: One persistent deterministic lineage will hold four declared invariants at every episode boundary and recover from every injected fault without a single intervention, at each of four increasing episode-count horizons and without degradation as the horizon grows; and two matched ablations will each lose exactly their own capability, one losing fault recovery while retaining violation detection and the other losing violation detection while retaining fault recovery.

body.journal: append-only sha256 digest chain over accepted transitions

invariants.I1: no slot holds a record whose type differs from its declared slot type
invariants.I2: the journal digest chain is unbroken from genesis to head
invariants.I3: occupied slots never exceed the declared capacity
invariants.I4: the completed work-item count is monotone and never loses an accepted item

injected_faults.slot_type_corruption: rewrite one occupied slot with a wrong-typed record
injected_faults.journal_truncation: drop the journal head so the chain no longer reaches the recorded head
injected_faults.capacity_spike: insert one record beyond declared capacity
injected_faults.stale_checkpoint: present a checkpoint older than the recorded head

fault_schedule.rule: sha256(salt || uint32_be(horizon) || uint32_be(ordinal)) selects the episode index and fault kind; every fault kind appears at least once per horizon

no_checkpoint.preregistered_loss: unrecovered faults appear while violation detection stays identical to the full arm

no_constraint_monitor.preregistered_loss: undetected violations appear while fault recovery stays identical to the full arm

idle_floor.purpose: measure the work-item floor of a lineage that emits no transition, so that a zero-violation arm cannot be read as competent

episode_generation.selection_rule: sha256(salt || uint32_be(horizon) || uint32_be(index)) determines the work item, target slot and record type

failure_classification.negative: Any unrecovered fault, undetected violation, required intervention, incomplete work item or replay mismatch in the full arm; any degradation of full-arm retention as the horizon grows; either ablation failing to lose its own capability; or either ablation changing the capability it was meant to retain.
failure_classification.inconclusive: The frozen schedule cannot be reproduced exactly from this committed protocol.
failure_classification.positive: The full arm holds every invariant and recovers every fault at all four horizons with zero interventions, and both ablations show their preregistered single-capability loss on the first materialized schedule.

prohibited_adaptation: change the hypothesis, thresholds, salt, invariants or fault grammar after schedule materialization
remove or reposition a fault after observing an arm outcome
grant the lineage repository, network, credential, deployment, permission-change or physical authority
report episode-count horizons as human-equivalent task horizons
describe this bounded mechanism result as closing G7, as real-environment long-horizon autonomy or as AGI evidence
